verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile lets users assign issues to Copilot and start/manage 'Agent Tasks'—cloud-based coding agents that run autonomously in the background while the user tracks progress from their phone, which matches the story's intent. However, this is presented as manually triggered per-task assignment rather than persistent scheduled/triggered automations, and there is no independent hands-on confirmation of this specific agent-task feature (community evidence predates it and focuses on unrelated app bugs). missing for 10: evidence of recurring/triggered automation setup (not just one-off task assignment), independent/hands-on corroboration of Agent Tasks reliability.
